dcterms:description: The EmoContext task dataset consists of conversations extracted from social media, annotated with emotional labels including Happy, Sad, Angry, and an 'other' category for unannotated emotions.
dcterms:title: EmoContext Dataset

dcterms:description: Pre-trained Google word embeddings used for transforming words into 300-dimensional vectors based on a vocabulary of 3 million words trained on approximately 100 billion words from Google News.
dcterms:title: Google Word Embeddings

dcterms:description: Pre-trained GloVe word embeddings consisting of 300-dimensional vectors trained on a vocabulary of 2.2 million words from data crawled from generic web pages.
dcterms:title: GloVe Word Embeddings

dcterms:description: Sentiment140 dataset used to create word embeddings for positive and negative tweets, employing a word2vec skip-gram strategy.
dcterms:title: Sentiment140 Dataset

dcterms:description: Generic Tweets dataset used to create word embeddings from 1.1 million generic tweets in English language.
dcterms:title: Generic Tweets Dataset
